title: 第二十五章对峙圣人第二十六章星斗战元始
slug: 洪荒走向神话的大天尊
content_zh:
元始天尊立于星空之中，周身庆云翻涌，圣人之威如渊如岳，压得周天星辰都微微一滞。
此言一出，气氛陡然凝固。
接引、准提、太上老君、通天教主、女娲娘娘分列各处，六圣齐聚，虽未刻意释放威压，但那六股至高无上的气息交织在一起，连星空都为之震颤。
昊天却是面色如常，负手而立，嘴角甚至还挂着一丝笑意。
“元始师兄此言差矣。”他缓缓开口，声音不大，却在星空中回荡不绝，“朕何曾藐视圣人？朕只是请诸位师兄师姐做个见证，此乃天庭与妖族余孽之间的私怨，与旁人无关。”
他目光扫过六圣，不卑不亢：“太古星空与三十三重天，乃朕受道祖敕封、天道加冕的天庭辖地。在此地，朕为主，诸位为客。客随主便，此乃常理。”
“放肆！”元始天尊眉头一拧，“区区一个童子，也敢在我等面前论主客？”
昊天微微一笑，不急不恼：“元始师兄若觉得朕说得不对，大可向道祖申诉。只是今日，在这天庭之地，朕说了算。”
这话说得不轻不重，却硬得很。
元始天尊脸色愈发难看，正要发作，却被太上老君轻轻拦住。
“二弟，稍安勿躁。”太上老君捋了捋胡须，目光落在昊天身上，“昊天，你且说说，你想如何处置陆压？”
昊天见太上老君开口，态度倒是缓和了几分，拱手道：“太上师兄明鉴。陆压乃妖族余孽，手持混沌钟，欲逃往混沌。
朕身为天庭之主，自当将他擒拿，收回天庭至宝。此事与诸位师兄无关，诸位只需旁观便是。”
“若是我们不答应呢？”准提道人忽然开口，脸上依旧挂着笑容，眼中却精光闪烁。
昊天看向准提，淡淡道：“不答应，那便请诸位离开天庭辖地。太古星空不欢迎心怀叵测之人。”
“你——”准提脸色一僵。
接引道人拉了拉准提的衣袖，低声道：“师弟，且看他如何行事。混沌钟虽好，却也不是那么容易到手的。”
他说话的同时，向着四周示意一下。那意思很明了，并不是只有他们两个人，还有着三清与女娲呢。
与其和昊天在这儿言语争执，不如让昊天将混沌钟拿到手，甚至直接让昊天得到。
陆压手里拿着混沌钟，真往混沌中一钻，谁也找不到，都拿他没办法。

但是昊天就不同，他身为洪荒天帝，是不可能离开洪荒的。
所以在这方面，混沌钟在昊天的手中比在陆压的手中更加稳妥。
至于后面能不能抢过来，到时候再看，毕竟三清和女娲也不是来看戏的。
准提与准提这么多年的师兄弟，早就心意相通了，他深吸一口气，压下心中不快，冷哼一声，不再言语。
通天教主一直未曾开口，此时忽然问道：“昊天，你当真觉得自己能拿下混沌钟，那可是先天至宝。”
昊天笑道：“通天师兄放心，朕既然敢动手，自然有把握。”
通天教主点了点头，不再追问，眼中却多了几分兴味。
女娲娘娘一直默然不语，谁也不知道她想些什么。
昊天见六圣不再言语，也不再耽搁，转身看向周天星斗大阵中的陆压。
陆压被困在大阵之中，头顶混沌钟，金光缭绕，却怎么也冲不破那星斗之力构成的牢笼。
content_en:
Yuanshi Tianzun stood in the starry sky, with clouds of joy rolling around him. The majesty of the saint was like an abyss or a mountain, and the stars in the surrounding sky stagnated slightly.
As soon as these words came out, the atmosphere suddenly solidified.
Jieyin, Zhunti, Taishang Laojun, Tongtian Cult Leader, and Nuwa Empress were all arranged in various places. The six saints gathered together. Although they did not deliberately release their pressure, the six supreme auras were intertwined and even the starry sky trembled.
Haotian, however, looked as usual, standing with his hands behind his back, and there was even a hint of a smile on his lips.
"Senior Brother Yuanshi's words are wrong." He spoke slowly, his voice was not loud, but it echoed endlessly in the starry sky, "How have I ever despised a saint? I just ask all brothers and sisters to be witnesses. This is a private grudge between the Heavenly Court and the remnants of the demon clan, and has nothing to do with anyone else."
He glanced at the six saints, neither humble nor arrogant: "The ancient starry sky and the thirty-third heaven are the jurisdiction of the heaven where I was entrusted by the Taoist ancestors and crowned by the heaven. Here, I am the master and you are the guests. It is common sense for guests to do as they please."
"Presumptuous!" Yuanshi Tianzun frowned, "A mere boy dares to discuss host and guest in front of us?"
Haotian smiled slightly, neither anxious nor annoyed: "Senior brother Yuanshi, if you think what I said is wrong, you can appeal to Dao Ancestor. But today, in this land of heaven, I have the final say."
This is neither a light nor a serious statement, but it is very hard.
Yuanshi Tianzun's face became increasingly ugly, and he was about to have an attack, but was gently stopped by Taishang Laojun.
"Second brother, please be patient." Taishang Laojun stroked his beard and looked at Haotian, "Haotian, tell me, how do you want to deal with Lu Ya?"
When Haotian saw Taishang Laojun speaking, his attitude softened a bit, and he cupped his hands and said: "Senior Brother Taishang Mingjian. Lu Ya is a remnant of the demon clan, holding a Chaos Bell, and wants to escape to Chaos.
As the Lord of Heaven, I should capture him and take back the treasure of Heaven. This matter has nothing to do with you senior brothers, you just need to watch. "
"What if we don't agree?" Taoist Zhunti suddenly spoke, with a smile still on his face but a glint in his eyes.
Haotian looked at Zhunti and said calmly: "If you don't agree, then please leave the jurisdiction of the Heavenly Court. People with ulterior motives are not welcome in the ancient starry sky."
"You——" Zhunti's face froze.
The Taoist guide pulled Zhunti's sleeve and whispered: "Junior brother, let's see how he behaves. Although the Chaos Bell is good, it is not that easy to get."
As he spoke, he gestured around. The meaning is very clear, they are not the only ones, there are also Sanqing and Nuwa.
Instead of having a verbal argument with Haotian here, it would be better to let Haotian get the Chaos Clock, or even let Haotian get it directly.
Lu Ya held the Chaos Clock in his hand, and when he really dug into the chaos, he couldn't find anyone, and there was nothing he could do.
But Haotian is different. As the Emperor of Prehistoric Heaven, it is impossible for him to leave Prehistoric Heaven.
So in this regard, the Chaos Clock is more secure in Haotian's hands than in Lu Ya's hands.
As for whether we can grab it later, we will see when the time comes. After all, Sanqing and Nuwa are not here to watch the show.
Zhunti and Zhunti have been brothers for so many years, and they have already known each other. He took a deep breath, suppressed his unhappiness, snorted coldly, and said no more.
Leader Tongtian, who had not spoken until now, suddenly asked: "Haotian, do you really think you can win the Chaos Bell? It is an innate treasure."
Haotian smiled and said: "Senior brother Tongtian, don't worry, since I dare to take action, I am sure."
Leader Tongtian nodded and stopped asking, but there was a little more interest in his eyes.
Empress Nuwa remained silent, and no one knew what she was thinking.
Seeing that the Six Saints were no longer speaking, Haotian stopped delaying and turned to look at Lu Ya in the Zhoutian Xingdou Formation.
Lu Ya was trapped in the formation, with the Chaos Bell above his head and golden light swirling around his head, but he could not break through the cage formed by the power of the stars.
